transcript: If you want the softest no spread sugar cookie recipe then you're going to want to save this one. It's by Lulu and Stone and I've got the recipe card here which I'm going to follow today. First things first, preheat your oven to 160°F. Using the paddle attachment on your mixer, mix together the butter and sugar until well combined. Not too long or your cookies will spread. Add in one egg and a teaspoon of vanilla extract and mix to combine. Add flour and mix on a low speed until just combined. Make sure not to overwork your dough. Just grab down the paddle and the sides of your bowl and shape into a ball. Lightly flour your work surface and roll your dough in the flour to coat. Roll out your cookie dough to a 6mm thickness. You can use dowels or guides like I have here. Make sure to move your dough around to avoid sticking. Cut out your shapes and place onto a lined baking tray. Once you're done, you're going to place your tray into the freezer for 15 minutes. For best results, don't roll out your dough more than twice. Make your chilled cookies for 10 to 12 minutes. Then use a fondant smoother to smooth the top of those cookies. Transfer onto a baking rack and allow to cook completely before decorating. Time for a taste test. Ask me when I tell you this is one of the best sugar cookie recipes you will make. Not only are there no spread but they are deliciously sweet and melt in your mouth. Have to try them.
